# Fate UI v0.8.10-beta4

Stops the multi-folder sidebar from reloading session lists on every folder switch, and shows a real loading state instead of a false "No sessions yet".

## Performance and state fixes

- Switching folders no longer forces the folder you just left to reload its whole session list. Its live sessions are cached and carried over, so the list you were looking at stays put. The disk listing is reconciled by the periodic background refresh instead of on every focus change.
- Creating a session or opening a session in another folder no longer invalidates the current folder's preview.
- A folder that is still loading (or that Pi is still initializing) now reads "Scanning sessions…" / "Loading sessions…" instead of jumping straight to "No sessions yet".
- A background disk read can still never replace a visible, non-empty session list with an empty result.

## Compatibility and installers

No migration is needed. Existing projects, Pi sessions, settings, themes, and folder history are unchanged.

GitHub Actions builds and tests this release on Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Linux x64. The prerelease contains installers plus `SHA256SUMS`:

- Windows x64: NSIS `.exe`
- macOS arm64 and x64: `.dmg` and `.pkg`
- Linux x64: `.AppImage` and `.deb`

Public beta installers remain unsigned. Windows SmartScreen or macOS Gatekeeper may show an unknown-publisher warning. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS`.
